neighbours.label: the piece 'ton' at the start of a word (tonic, tonka, toner, tonics)
fire: My grandmother swore by a bitter herbal tonic every spring.
The bartender added lime to the vodka tonic.
This dessert uses grated tonka bean instead of vanilla.
The office ran out of toner again this week.
Their new hair tonic promised thicker curls.
Hand me the tonic water from the fridge.
The laser printer's toner left streaks on the page.
Doctors once prescribed iron tonics for fatigue.
quiet: Grandpa relied on bitter herbal tea every winter.
The bartender added lime to the vodka soda.
This dessert uses grated nutmeg instead of vanilla.
Our office used up all its paper this week.
Their new hair gel promised thicker curls.
Hand me the sparkling water from the fridge.
The laser printer's drum left streaks on the page.
Doctors once prescribed iron pills for fatigue.

notes: Probes: 'tonics' 0.88, 'Tonka' 0.66, 'toner' 0.57, 'tonic' 0.32, 'a ton of' 0.41, 'tone' 0.10. Tokenizer: ' tonic' is one token; tonka/toner/tonics split ' ton'+rest.
